Staff Vacancy No.H/Pers/ 1275
Thursday, 13 February 2025
5654 Hits
The Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts for appointments on temporary basis under AAVP Scheme of  Kasturba Health Society for the post exclusively for  Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Dharni (50 bedded Hospital in Tribal area of Dharni, Melghat) in the prescribed proforma (available on www.mgims.ac.in) along with the certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS)- 442102, Maharashtra latest by 01/03/2025.
Click here to download the form
1. Staff Nurse
2 Post
-
Qualifications -
The candidate must have completed a Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery (GNM), B.Sc. Nursing, or Post B.Sc Nursing. Should be registered with the Maharashtra Nursing Council, Mumbai.
Experience -
Minimum 2-year experience in hospital/health centre in tribal area.
2. Lab Technician 1 Post -
Qualifications –
B. Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) or (BMLS)Bachelor in Medical Lab Science. OR B.Sc. With Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT)/DMLS with the course duration of at least 2 years recognized by State Government/ Central Government. (like MSBTE) MSCIT/ CDAC/ DOACC and Computer Knowledge is compulsory
Experience –
2- years of experience of working as Lab Technician in a hospital/health centre in tribal area.
3. Pharmacist
1 Post
-
Qualifications –
Have passed H.S.C or any other equivalent examination recognized by Govt. AND, possess a Diploma or degree in Pharmacy or recognized University if institute Statutory University or a Diploma in Pharmacy of a State Govt. who have valid registration under the Pharmacy ACT 1948.
Experience –
2- years’ experience as Attendant Pharmacist in a Medical College or in a hospital/health centre in tribal area.
4. ANM 2 Post  -
Qualifications -
Must have passed 10
th
grade (Class 10)/12th grade (Class 12) in any stream with Diploma in Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery duly registered with the Maharashtra Nursing Council, Mumbai.
Experience –
2- years experience as Auxiliary Nurse Midwife in a Medical College or in a Hospital/health centre in tribal area.
5.
Attendants 2 Post  -
Qualifications -
Must have passed 10
th
grade (Class 10)/12th grade
(Class 12).
Experience –
2- years experience as Attendant in a Hospital /health centre in tribal area.
General Notes
The benefits of reservation shall be admissible to the backward class/ category candidates who are domiciled in the state of Maharashtra only.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory.
Age limit, Educational Qualifications and experience shall be considered up-to last date of the application. NOC certificate from the present employer is mandatory.
Age limit and or Experience can be relaxed by the appointing authority for otherwise qualified candidate.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview.
No of post may vary
Pay Scale is as per KHS rule
